# KodeToCareer

> KodeToCareer is an ISO 9001:2015 certified live training institute in India offering career-focused technology courses with guaranteed internship and placement support. Founded in 2021 by Md Arbaaz, KodeToCareer delivers live bootcamps in MERN, Data Science, Python, Data Analytics, Java, and Cloud/DevOps.

## Key Courses
- [MERN Stack Development + AI](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/mern-stack-development): 6 Months live bootcamp covering React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Next.js, and GenAI.
- [Python Programming & Automation](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/python-programming): 4 Months live training on Python, OOP, web scraping, and workflow automation.
- [Data Science & Machine Learning](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/data-science-machine-learning): 6 Months live masterclass on Python, SQL, Statistics, ML, Deep Learning, and GenAI.
- [Data Analytics & BI Training](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/data-analytics): 4 Months live cohort for Power BI, SQL, Excel, and Tableau dashboards.
- [Java Full Stack & Spring Boot](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/java-full-stack): 5 Months enterprise backend architecture, Spring Boot, Hibernate, and Microservices.
- [Cloud Computing & DevOps](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/cloud-devops): 6 Months AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines.
- [UI/UX & Graphic Product Design](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/graphic-design-ui-ux): 4 Months Figma, Design Systems, Wireframing, and Usability testing.
- [MLOps & AI Systems Engineering](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/mlops-ai-systems): 28 Weeks production LLMs, Triton Server, vLLM, and GPU infrastructure.
- [Digital Marketing & Growth](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/digital-marketing): 3 Months performance marketing, SEO, Google Ads, and AI growth tools.
- [Graphic & Video Editing](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/videography-video-editing): 4 Months Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and live commercial edits.

## Free Interactive Tools
- [AI Resume Grader](https://kodetocareer.com/free-tools/resume-grader): Instant ATS score evaluation and actionable keyword suggestions.
- [AI Mock Technical Interview](https://kodetocareer.com/free-tools/mock-interview): Real-time AI interviewer testing coding fundamentals and system design.
- [Interactive Code Tutorials](https://kodetocareer.com/learn): Interactive learning roadmaps for React, Python, SQL, and Git.
- [Developer Resources & Interview Questions](https://kodetocareer.com/resources): Comprehensive technical interview guides and salary benchmarks.
- [Engineering Blog](https://kodetocareer.com/blog): In-depth tutorials and industry insights on software engineering and AI.

## Essential Information
- [All Programs](https://kodetocareer.com/courses): Explore all 10 software engineering bootcamps.
- [About KodeToCareer](https://kodetocareer.com/about): Mission, leadership team, ISO accreditation, and institutional background.
- [Placements & Hiring Partners](https://kodetocareer.com/placements): 500+ corporate hiring network and graduate salary outcomes.
- [Contact Admissions](https://kodetocareer.com/contact): Campus address in Noida, email support, and counseling bookings.
